articles.title: Lanka, India begin Mitra Shakti XII military exercise
articles.description: The Sri Lankan and Indian armies have begun the 12th edition of their annual bilateral military exercise, Exercise Mitra Shakti XII–2026, at the Army Training School, in Maduru Oya. The exercise, being held from November 13 to 26, is aimed at strengthening military cooperation, operational capabilities and interoperability between the two neighbouring countries.
